competitors.name: C&S Wholesale Grocers / Sol Select
competitors.action: C&S launched Sol Select, a new value private-label line with more than 250 products, including frozen pizza, using bilingual packaging and an immediate rollout through Grand Union, Piggly Wiggly, and independent grocers before a broader SpartanNash expansion this summer.

competitors.name: Conagra
competitors.action: Conagra named John Brase as its next CEO effective June 1, putting a major center-store and frozen-food operator under new leadership just as large CPG portfolios keep leaning harder on efficiency, brand focus, and category prioritization.

competitors.name: General Mills / TNT Crust
competitors.action: General Mills is moving ahead with the shutdown of its St. Charles pizza-crust plant, a supply-chain signal worth watching because it tightens where scaled crust production sits and reinforces how aggressively big food companies are consolidating manufacturing around core volume.

trends.topic: Frozen pizza and adjacent freezer categories are being squeezed from both ends by private-label expansion and big-CPG portfolio consolidation
trends.magnitude: Retailers are widening own-brand reach while manufacturers centralize leadership and production.
trends.context: For Real Dough, the opportunity is to stay clearly premium and story-led, because value tiers are getting broader and scaled incumbents are getting leaner at the same time.

market_data.value: 250+ products across frozen, center-store, dairy, and household

market_data.metric: General Mills St. Charles pizza-crust layoffs
market_data.value: 163 workers affected ahead of June 8, 2026 closure

breaking.headline: The sharpest signal today is value-layer expansion around frozen pizza, not flashy innovation
breaking.impact: C&S is widening private-label frozen distribution while Conagra and General Mills show the parallel big-CPG playbook, tighter leadership focus and tighter manufacturing footprints. Real Dough should keep leaning into differentiation that private label cannot copy quickly.
